sparse_storage_contract.teacher_authority: COO pair_region_indices plus pair_view_indices plus float32 pair_descriptors plus per-pair crop/hit/coverage evidence

capacity_rationale.region_cap_reason: 4096 supplies substantially more source-only region diversity than the 64 rows consumed per scene per epoch while bounding validation and host storage; it was chosen from the frozen trainer schedule, not a benchmark result
capacity_rationale.view_cap_reason: four independent source views preserve multi-view mean, dispersion, and disagreement supervision while reducing the 120-view worst case by 30x; selection is exact source coverage based and not score tuned

validation_gates: synthetic exact sampling/top-K determinism and tie-break tests
validator rejects dense-v1 impostors, duplicate COO pairs, non-unit descriptors, wrong Accepted/state/source lineage, and per-scene cap violations
trainer tests prove only requested batch rows are locally gathered
existing full-scalar source-only test suite remains green
real scene preflight reports candidate/selected/pair/storage counts before any model execution
